digest.component_or_area: outbound parent reconciliation (CREATE emit and ACLI attach fallback)
propositions: CREATE emit path drops a non-epic parent silently with only debug logging, leaving no durable bridge_alerts record
ACLI attach fallback swallows HTTP 400 when Jira rejects a non-epic parent, logging a warning but recording no parent divergence alert
Two suppressed parent surfaces lack the bridge_alerts durability guarantee that UPDATE emit and UPDATE apply paths enforce, violating the project's stated contract
CREATE emit must report dropped bound non-epic parents via the existing dropped_field_sink -> outbound-field-dropped channel, mirroring the UPDATE emit fix from ticket 9f26
ACLI 400 rejection must call record_parent_divergence with kind outbound-parent-rejected, matching the pattern dispatch_one uses for identical rejection shapes
Unbound parents must remain silent on both CREATE and ACLI paths, as they converge on later passes and alerting on them would be churn
